newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Klabin downgraded to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Klabin downgraded to hold.

text.p: -- CS First Boston said in a statement it downgraded Brazilian pulp and paper manufacturer Industrias Klabin Papel e Celulose to hold from buy.
-- It said the firm posted lower-than-expected third quarter results due to weak pulp and paper prices.
-- It also reduced Klabin's 1996 earnings estimates to $0.78 from $0.97 per ADS and 1997 estimates to $0.96 from $1.04 per ADS.
-- CS First Boston said it cut its target price for Klabin to $11 per ADS from $12.50 per ADS, noting it does not believe Klabin offers a compelling valuation to justify its risk.
-- Also, it said high inventory levels were likely to prevent any short-term rally in pulp and paper prices.
-- Klabin preferred shares were flat at 1.02 reais.
